resolution_notes: base_url: incorrect. Current official docs specify https://search.api.careerjet.net/v4/query, replacing the dead public.api host. example: incorrect. Official docs require Basic authentication (API key as username, empty password), user_ip and user_agent; locale_code is the current parameter, page_size replaces pagesize, and jobs use locations plus an RFC-style date. Evidence: https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/
